look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: examine a small white, five-lobed flower arising singly or in a pair from a leaf axil; the leaves are simple with smooth (entire) margins, and a shallow persistent calyx sits at the base of the developing pepper fruit.
diagnostic_image_needs: ripe and unripe fruit on same plant
